summary: Iteration 3 testing complete. Backend: 12/13 pytest cases pass (Stripe checkout creation, BA/BSC courses, projects CRUD, RBAC all verified). Frontend: title/navbar/footer branding, /placements (4 KPIs + 10 recruiter logos as images), /projects (6+ cards), /courses (5), Stripe pay-with-Stripe redirect to checkout.stripe.com all working. ONE CRITICAL BUG: GET /api/payments/status/{session_id} returns 500 because emergentintegrations library cannot retrieve the session it just created via the same STRIPE_API_KEY=sk_test_emergent (Stripe says 'No such checkout.session'). This breaks the success-return polling in StudentDashboard Fees.

critical.issue: Returns 500 InvalidRequestError 'No such checkout.session: cs_test_...' for sessions created seconds earlier via the SAME backend instance using the SAME STRIPE_API_KEY. Backend traceback: emergentintegrations/payments/stripe/checkout.py:191 stripe.checkout.Session.retrieve(). The sk_test_emergent key appears to create sessions on one Stripe sandbox account but retrieve via another (or the public-facing pk in checkout URL belongs to a different account: pk_test_51RiH9TFfKOFR3CQU... visible in checkout iframe URL). This breaks the post-payment polling flow in /student-dashboard/fees?session_id=...

minor.issue: First call after a cold start can take ~30s (Stripe API latency); subsequent calls ~3s. Increase frontend timeout/loader.

integration_issues.issue: When user returns from Stripe to /student-dashboard/fees?session_id=..., the polling call to /api/payments/status/{session_id} will hit the 500 bug above and the fee will never auto-update to 'paid' in UI even though webhook may have updated DB.

action_items: Investigate emergentintegrations Stripe session retrieve mismatch — verify STRIPE_API_KEY env at runtime, ensure StripeCheckout instance uses same secret key for both create and retrieve. Possibly the sk_test_emergent placeholder maps to two different test accounts internally. Add try/except around get_checkout_status in /api/payments/status to return 502 with friendly message instead of 500.

Optionally: rely on Stripe webhook (already wired at /api/webhook/stripe) to update fee paid status, and have polling endpoint fall back to reading payment_transactions doc from Mongo if Stripe API call fails.
Frontend: surface a friendly fallback when polling returns 5xx (currently student sees fee still 'pending' silently).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1200 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline. Strongly recommend splitting into routers/auth.py, routers/academics.py, routers/payments.py, routers/admin.py, models/.
CORS_ORIGINS=* combined with allow_credentials=True is invalid per CORS spec; browsers will refuse to send cookies. Set explicit origins if cookie auth is desired.
_stripe_checkout() is recreated per request — fine for now but consider caching at module level since webhook_url is derived from request.base_url.
/api/payments/status route does not validate that the session belongs to the authenticated user (only that txn exists). Add: if user.role==student and txn.student_email != user.email -> 403.
Old /api/fees/{id}/pay (mock) is still active and bypasses Stripe — could be abused by any logged-in student. Either gate behind admin-only or remove now that Stripe is real.
seed_admin and seed_demo_users are idempotent — good.

rca of the issue: Stripe payment status RCA — emergentintegrations.payments.stripe.checkout.StripeCheckout.create_checkout_session() and get_checkout_status() are both initialised with api_key=os.environ['STRIPE_API_KEY']='sk_test_emergent'. The create call succeeds and returns a session URL containing pk_test_51RiH9TFfKOFR3CQU... (a Stripe-managed Emergent test account). However when get_checkout_status calls stripe.checkout.Session.retrieve(session_id) using the secret key, Stripe returns 'No such checkout.session'. This indicates the secret key context used for retrieve does not match the one used during create — possibly because the emergentintegrations library proxies create through Emergent's backend but retrieve directly hits Stripe with a different key. Reproduction: 1) login as student, 2) POST /api/fees/{any_pending_id}/checkout -> returns valid URL, 3) GET /api/payments/status/{session_id} -> 500. Mitigation: a) wrap get_checkout_status in try/except, fall back to DB status, b) trust the webhook handler to mark fee paid (already wired), c) report to emergentintegrations maintainers.
